meta.name: acquisition-channel-advisor
meta.description: Evaluate acquisition channels using unit economics, customer quality, and scalability. Use when deciding whether to scale, test, or kill a growth channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估获客渠道的单位经济学和可扩展性来指导增长决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要量化判断哪些获客渠道值得加大投入
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate acquisition channels by unit economics and scalability to guide growth decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need data-driven decisions on which acquisition channels to scale

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会通过提问评估你指定的获客渠道（如Google Ads），从单位经济、客户质量、可扩展性和战略匹配四个维度分析，最终给出“大力扩展”“测试优化”或“放弃或暂停”三种建议。
howto.when: 当你要求评估某个获客渠道是否值得继续投入预算，或需要决定是扩展、测试还是放弃该渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估LinkedIn广告这个获客渠道是否值得继续投入。
say.note: Claude会询问渠道数据并进行评估。

say.text: 对比内容营销、外发邮件和合作伙伴推荐三种渠道的质量。
say.note: Claude会依次分析各渠道给出比较。

say.text: 告诉我是否应该扩大或放弃我们的网络研讨会获客渠道。
say.note: Claude会给出具体的扩展或放弃建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask questions to evaluate a user-specified acquisition channel (e.g., Google Ads) across unit economics, customer quality, scalability, and strategic fit, then recommend 'scale aggressively', 'test & optimize', or 'kill or pause'.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to evaluate whether an acquisition channel deserves more budget, or need to decide whether to scale, test, or kill it.

say_en.text: Evaluate whether LinkedIn ads channel is worth continued investment.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for channel data and assess.

say_en.text: Compare content marketing, outbound email, and partner referrals.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze each channel and compare.

say_en.text: Should we scale or kill our webinar acquisition channel?
say_en.note: Claude will provide specific scale or kill recommendation.
